rows.address: 江苏省苏州市姑苏区双塔街道凤凰街小区江苏省苏州第十中学
rows.intro: 苏州文庙位于中国江苏省苏州市姑苏区，为宋代范仲淹所创建，以拥有《平江图》等“四大宋碑”而著称于世。苏州文庙建筑面积仅次于曲阜孔庙，列全国第二大孔庙，有“东南学宫之首”、“天下第一庙学”之称 。1961年，苏州文庙内宋代石刻被中华人民共和国国务院公布为第一批全国重点文物保护单位之一，2001年，苏州文庙并入后称为苏州文庙及石刻。现已辟为苏州碑刻博物馆。
rows.intro_en:
Location: Suzhou Confucian Temple
The Suzhou Confucian Temple is located in Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China. Founded by Fan Zhongyan in the Song Dynasty, it is renowned for the "Four Great Song Steles," including the Pingjiang Map. With a building area second only to the Confucius Temple in Qufu, it ranks as the second largest Confucian temple in the country, and is known as "the foremost academy-temple in Southeast China" and "the finest temple-school under heaven." In 1961, the Song Dynasty stone carvings in the Suzhou Confucian Temple were designated by the State Council of the People's Republic of China as one of the first group of Major Historical and Cultural Sites Protected at the National Level. In 2001, the Suzhou Confucian Temple was merged, and became known as the Suzhou Confucian Temple and Stone Carvings. It has now been converted into the Suzhou Institute of Stele Carvings Museum.
rows.address_en: Jiangsu Suzhou No. 10 High School, Fenghuang Street Community, Shuangta Subdistrict, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu

rows.intro_en: Beiting Ancient City National Archaeological Site Park, located in Jimsar County, Changji Hui Autonomous Prefecture, Xinjiang, preserves the ruins of the seat of the Tang dynasty's Beiting Protectorate. A nationally protected key cultural site, it offers visitors the remnants of the ancient city walls along with exhibitions of related unearthed artifacts.

rows.intro: 西溪国家湿地公园位于杭州市西部，是集城市湿地、农耕湿地和文化湿地于一体的国家湿地公园，以水网密布、芦苇摇曳的自然风光著称，游客可乘船游览，体验“一曲溪流一曲烟”的意境。
rows.intro_en: Xixi National Wetland Park, located in the western part of Hangzhou, is a national wetland park integrating urban wetland, agricultural wetland, and cultural wetland. It is renowned for its natural scenery of dense waterways and swaying reeds. Visitors can take a boat tour and experience the poetic ambiance of "a winding stream accompanied by drifting mist."
rows.address_en: Jiangcun Subdistrict, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

rows.name_zh: 三坊七巷历史文化街区
rows.name_en: Sanfang Qixiang Historic and Cultural Block (Three Lanes and Seven Alleys)

rows.intro: 三坊七巷历史文化街区位于福州市中心，是保存较为完整的历史街区，坊巷格局延续至今，汇集众多古民居建筑，被誉为“里坊制度活化石”，是福州著名的文化旅游地标。
rows.intro_en: The Sanfang Qixiang Historical and Cultural District is located in the center of Fuzhou. It is a relatively well-preserved historic district whose lane-and-alley layout has continued to this day. It gathers numerous ancient residential buildings and is known as a "living fossil of the lane-and-ward system," making it a famous cultural tourism landmark of Fuzhou.
rows.address_en: No. 6 Wenru Fang, Dongjiekou Business Area, Nanjie Subdistrict, Gulou District, Fuzhou City, Fujian Province, China

rows.name_en: Three Lanes and Seven Alleys Scenic Area, Gulou District

rows.intro: 三坊七巷位于福州市鼓楼区，是格局保存完好的明清历史文化街区，白墙黛瓦的坊巷间曾走出众多近现代名人，被誉为中国城市里坊制度活化石。
name_aliases: 三坊七巷历史文化街区
中国城市里坊制度活化石
rows.review_summary: 这里是遛娃宝藏地，适合亲子同乐，既能观赏历史建筑，又是赏花胜地，适合城市漫步，夜游观景也很出彩。
rows.intro_en: Sanfang Qixiang (Three Lanes and Seven Alleys) is located in Gulou District, Fuzhou. It is a historic and cultural district of the Ming and Qing dynasties with a well-preserved layout. From its white-walled, dark-tiled lanes and alleys emerged numerous notable figures of modern times, and it is hailed as a living fossil of China's traditional urban ward system.
rows.address_en: Nanhou Street Pedestrian Street, Nanjie Subdistrict, Gulou District, Fuzhou, Fujian Province — Sanfang Qixiang (Three Lanes and Seven Alleys)
review_tags_en: Hidden gem for taking kids out
rows.review_summary_en:
Location: Sanfang Qixiang (Three Lanes and Seven Alleys) Scenic Area, Gulou District

This is a hidden gem for family outings with kids, perfect for parent-child fun. Here you can admire historic architecture and enjoy flower viewing alike—ideal for a city stroll, and the night scenery is equally impressive.

rows.intro: 崀山风景名胜区位于湖南省邵阳市新宁县，属丹霞地貌景区，以辣椒峰、骆驼峰、八角寨等奇特峰林景观闻名，是国家5A级旅游景区和世界自然遗产地。
rows.intro_en: Langshan Scenic Area is located in Xinning County, Shaoyang City, Hunan Province. It is a Danxia landform scenic area, famous for its spectacular peak forests such as Chilli Peak, Camel Peak, and Bajiao Village (Octagonal Fortress). It is a national 5A-level tourist attraction and a World Natural Heritage site.
rows.address_en: Langshan Scenic Area, Langshan Town, Xinning County, Shaoyang City, Hunan Province, China

rows.address: 浙江省丽水市缙云县仙都街道仙都绿道缙云仙都景区
rows.intro: 缙云仙都景区位于浙江丽水缙云县，以鼎湖峰奇石和好溪山水闻名，相传是黄帝炼丹升天之地，为国家5A级旅游景区和知名影视取景地。
rows.review_summary: 缙云仙都景区是遛娃宝藏地，适合亲子同乐，这里既是赏花胜地，游客还可登高爬山、乘船游览，游玩方式多样。
rows.intro_en: The Jinyun Xiandu Scenic Area is located in Jinyun County, Lishui, Zhejiang. It is famous for the strange rock of Dinghu Peak and the landscape along the Haoxi River. Legend has it that this is where the Yellow Emperor refined elixir and ascended to heaven. It is a national 5A-level tourist attraction and a well-known filming location.

Location: Jinyun Xiandu Scenic Area
Xiandu Greenway, Xiandu Subdistrict, Jinyun County, Lishui City, Zhejiang Province, Jinyun Xiandu Scenic Area
rows.review_summary_en:
Location: Jinyun Xiandu Scenic Area

Jinyun Xiandu Scenic Area is a hidden gem for taking kids out, perfect for family fun. It is also a great place for flower viewing; visitors can also climb the mountains and take boat rides, offering a variety of ways to enjoy the visit.

rows.intro_en: The China Museum for Fujian-Taiwan Kinship, located in Quanzhou, Fujian, is a national-level specialized museum reflecting the historical ties between Fujian and Taiwan. Through artifacts, photographs, and scene displays, it showcases the shared roots, culture, and bloodline connections between Fujian and Taiwan.

rows.intro_en: Yanzhou Ancient City is located in Meicheng, Jiande, Hangzhou, at the confluence of the Xin'an River, Lan River, and Fuchun River. It once served as the seat of Yanzhou Prefecture; its city walls, streets, and historical relics remain intact, offering a taste of the millennium-old prefectural cityscape.

rows.intro: 仙都，与黄山、庐山并列为轩辕黄帝的“三大行宫” ，是位于中国浙江省丽水市缙云县仙都街道的一处国家5A级旅游景区，分为鼎湖峰、大洋等等景区。通常所说的仙都风景区指位于缙云县城东向北七公里的鼎湖峰景区，面积76平方公里。景区地处括苍山北麓。瓯江上游，好溪中段 ，是首批国家4A级旅游景区，后于2020年1月申报5A级旅游景区成功 ，为丽水市首个5A级景区 。被人民日报称为“既有‘黄山之奇’，更有‘华山之险’，亦不乏‘桂林之秀’ 。亦是道教三十六洞天之仙都山洞，名曰仙都祈仙天 。
rows.intro_en: Xiandu, which tradition ranks alongside Huangshan and Lushan as one of the 'Three Great Palaces' of the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, is a national 5A-level tourist attraction in Xiandu Subdistrict, Jinyun County, Lishui City, Zhejiang Province, China, divided into areas such as Dinghu Peak and Dayang. What is usually called the Xiandu Scenic Area refers to the Dinghu Peak area, about seven kilometers northeast of the Jinyun county seat, covering 76 square kilometers. The area lies at the northern foot of the Kuocang Mountains, on the upper reaches of the Oujiang River and the middle course of the Haoxi. It was among the first national 4A-level scenic areas and was successfully upgraded to 5A in January 2020, becoming Lishui's first 5A-level scenic area. People's Daily has described it as having 'the marvels of Huangshan and the perils of Huashan, yet no lack of the grace of Guilin.' It is also the Xiandushan Cave among the thirty-six grotto-heavens of Daoism, named 'Xiandu Qixian Tian.'
rows.address_en: Jinyun Xiandu Scenic Area, Xiandu Greenway, Xiandu Subdistrict, Jinyun County, Lishui, Zhejiang

rows.address: 四川省成都市都江堰市灌口街道都江堰景区鱼嘴分水堤
rows.intro: 建造是土木工程的重要項目之一（圖為美國胡佛水壩）]] 水利工程（ ）是土木工程的一个分支，主要研究流体（特别是水和污水）的流动与输送。 这些系统的一个显著特征是广泛利用重力作为流体运动的驱动力。该领域与桥梁、水坝、河道、运河以及堤防的设计与施工密切相关，也涉及公共卫生与环境工程等用水相关的生态环境范畴。水利工程是流体力学原理在水的收集、储存、控制、输送、调节、测量和利用等实际问题中的应用。
rows.review_summary: 该水利工程具有地标意义，是理想的观景之地，游客可在此观赏地标景观，享受观景体验，值得前来游览观光。
rows.intro_en: Hydraulic engineering is one of the major projects in civil engineering (pictured: Hoover Dam, USA) Hydraulic engineering is a branch of civil engineering that primarily studies the flow and conveyance of fluids, particularly water and sewage. A distinctive feature of these systems is the extensive use of gravity as the driving force for fluid movement. This field is closely related to the design and construction of bridges, dams, channels, canals, and levees, and also involves water-related ecological and environmental areas such as public health and environmental engineering. Hydraulic engineering is the application of fluid mechanics principles to practical problems concerning the collection, storage, control, transport, regulation, measurement, and use of water.

rows.review_summary_en: This water conservancy project is a landmark and an ideal spot for sightseeing. Visitors can admire the landmark scenery and enjoy the viewing experience here, making it well worth a visit.

rows.intro_en: Huangguoshu Waterfall is located in Zhenning Buyei and Miao Autonomous County, Anshun, Guizhou Province, China. It is the largest of the nine-tier waterfall group on the Baishui River, a tributary of the Dabang River in the Pearl River system. The waterfall is 77.8 meters high, with the main cascade 67 meters high; it is 101 meters wide, with the main cascade 83.3 meters wide at its crest.

rows.intro_en: Chongqing Wildlife World is located in Yongchuan District, Chongqing. It is a large safari park combining drive-through sightseeing and walking tours, where visitors can observe lions, tigers, giraffes, and various other rare wild animals up close.

rows.intro_en: The Suzhou Institute of Inscription Steles is located in Suzhou. It mainly collects and displays stele relics from various dynasties. With numerous ancient stone carvings on display, it is an important place for learning about Suzhou's history, culture, and the art of calligraphy and stone inscription.

rows.intro_en: Dujiangyan Scenic Area is located in Dujiangyan City, northwest of Chengdu. It is a large-scale water conservancy project built under the direction of Li Bing and his son during the Warring States period. For more than two thousand years, it has continued to benefit the Chengdu Plain, and together with Mount Qingcheng, it is listed as a World Cultural Heritage site.

rows.intro_en: The Suzhou Opera Museum, also known as the China Kunqu Museum (abbreviated as Kunbo), is located in the Quanjin Guild Hall at No. 14 Zhongzhangjia Alley, Pingjiang Subdistrict, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, People's Republic of China. It is the first and currently the only public specialized museum in China themed on Kunqu opera. It is now designated as a National Second-Grade Museum.

rows.intro_en: Tibet Culture Museum, in Beijing, is themed on the history and culture of Tibet. Through relics, photographs and other exhibits it presents Tibet's historical evolution, religious art and folk customs, serving as an important window into Tibetan culture.

rows.address: 浙江省杭州市西湖区蒋村街道西溪国家湿地公园
rows.intro: 西溪湿地旅游区位于杭州西部，是中国首个国家湿地公园，以水网密布、芦苇摇曳、飞鸟成群的水乡风光著称，被誉为杭州的城市绿肺。
rows.review_summary: 西溪湿地旅游区地处杭州西湖区，是赏花胜地，游客可乘船游览，泛舟水上欣赏沿途花卉景致，体验赏花游船之乐。
rows.intro_en: Xixi Wetland Tourist Area, located in western Hangzhou, is China's first national wetland park. Renowned for its water-town scenery of crisscrossing waterways, swaying reeds, and flocks of birds, it is hailed as the green lung of Hangzhou.
rows.address_en: Xixi Wetland Tourism Zone, Xihu District
rows.review_summary_en:
Location: Xixi Wetland Tourist Area, Xihu District

The Xixi Wetland Tourist Area is located in Xihu District, Hangzhou. It is a renowned flower-viewing destination where visitors can take boat tours, drifting along the water to enjoy the floral scenery along the way and experience the pleasure of flower-viewing cruises.

name_aliases: 木垒哈萨克自治县博物馆
rows.intro_en: The Museum of Mori Kazakh Autonomous County is located in Changji Hui Autonomous Prefecture, Xinjiang. It is a venue showcasing the local historical evolution, unearthed cultural relics, and the ethnic customs and culture of the Kazakh and other ethnic groups, serving as a window for understanding the history and folk customs of Mori County.
rows.address_en: Nurgul East Road, Mulei Town, Mulei Kazakh Autonomous County, Changji Hui Autonomous Prefecture, Xinjiang, China
rows.opening_hours_en: Tuesday to Sunday 10:30-13:00, 15:30-19:00; opening hours on public holidays are subject to official announcements

rows.intro: 崀山景区位于湖南省邵阳市新宁县，是世界自然遗产“中国丹霞”的组成部分，以典型丹霞地貌著称，辣椒峰、八角寨、骆驼峰等景观奇特，扶夷江蜿蜒其间，山水秀美。
rows.intro_en: Langshan Scenic Area is located in Xinning County, Shaoyang City, Hunan Province. It is part of the World Natural Heritage site "China Danxia" and is renowned for its typical Danxia landforms. Scenic spots such as Chili Peak, Bajiao Village (Octagonal Fortress), and Camel Peak are remarkably unique, with the Fuyi River winding through the area, creating beautiful landscapes of mountains and water.

rows.intro_en: The Kashgar Regional Museum is located in Kashgar City, Xinjiang. It is a comprehensive museum showcasing Kashgar's history and culture as well as the civilization of the Silk Road. With its rich collection of cultural relics, it serves as an important window for understanding the historical evolution and ethnic customs of Kashgar and its surrounding areas.

rows.intro_en: Mori Kazakh Autonomous County Museum, located in Mori County, Changji Prefecture, Xinjiang, is a local museum presenting regional history, culture and Kazakh folk customs. rows.intro_en: Location: Lingbo Gate, East Lake South Road. Lingbo Gate is located on East Lake South Road in Wuhan, right next to Wuhan University. Its stone pier extends into the lake; it was once an open-air swimming pool of Wuhan University, and is now a popular spot for viewing sunrises and lake scenery.

rows.intro: 中国闽台缘博物馆位于福建泉州，是一座反映福建与台湾历史渊源关系的专题博物馆，通过文物、文献和场景展示两岸地缘、血缘、文缘、商缘、法缘的深厚联系。
rows.intro_en: China Museum for Fujian-Taiwan Kinship is located in Quanzhou, Fujian. It is a thematic museum reflecting the historical connections between Fujian and Taiwan. Through cultural relics, documents, and scene displays, it presents the deep ties between the two sides in geography, bloodlines, culture, commerce, and law.

rows.intro_en: Meicheng Ancient Town is located in Jiande, Hangzhou, at the confluence of the Xin'an River, Lan River, and Fuchun River. It takes its name from its battlements, which resemble plum blossoms. Once the seat of the ancient Yanzhou Prefecture, it boasts a profound historical heritage.

rows.intro_en:
Location: Lingbo Gate, Wuhan University

Lingbo Gate of Wuhan University is located on the shore of East Lake in Wuhan, on the lakeside of Wuhan University. It is famous for the stone trestle bridge extending into the lake, and is a popular spot for watching sunrise, playing in the water, and taking photos.
rows.address_en: 20 meters north of the intersection of Donghu South Road and Lingbo Road, Wuhan
